title: Playbook Front Matter
description: Front matter for .playbook.yaml files. Declares the playbook version and schema, which determines the vocabulary available in the content document.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Built-in: 'client' (UI runtime), 'server' (backend runtime). Domain: '{domain}-{platform}' extends a base schema.

name.description: Optional playbook name. If omitted, derived from the 'scenario' key in the content document.
